arxiv-1806-01405.title: On the Soundness of Coroutines with Snapshots
arxiv-1806-01405.creator: Aleksandar Prokopec, Fengyun Liu
arxiv-1806-01405.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Aleksandar Prokopec, Fengyun Liu. Coroutines are a general control flow construct that can eliminate control flow fragmentation inherent in event-driven programs, which is still missing in many popular languages. Coroutines with snapshots are a first-class, type-safe, stackful coroutine model, which unifies many variants of suspendable computing, and is sufficiently general to express iterators, single-assignment variables, async-await, actors, event streams, backtracking, symmetric coroutines and continuations.

arxiv-1906-03055.title: DG-Enhanced Hecke and KLR Algebras
arxiv-1906-03055.creator: Ruslan MAKSIMAU a and Pedro VAZ b
arxiv-1906-03055.description: Abstract We construct DG-enhanced versions of the degenerate affine Hecke algebra and of the affine Hecke algebra. We extend Brundan–Kleshchev and Rouquier’s isomorphism and prove that after completion DG-enhanced versions of affine Hecke algebras (degenerate or nondegenerate) are isomorphic to completed DG-enhanced versions of KLR algebras for suitably defined quivers.

arxiv-1908-04355.title: Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent Vulnerability Suppression
arxiv-1908-04355.creator: Divyam Madaan, Jinwoo Shin, Sung Ju Hwang
arxiv-1908-04355.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Divyam Madaan, Jinwoo Shin, Sung Ju Hwang. Despite the remarkable performance of deep neural networks on various computer vision tasks, they are known to be susceptible to adversarial perturbations, which makes it challenging to deploy them in real-world safety-critical applications. In this paper, we conjecture that the leading cause of adversarial vulnerability is the distortion in the latent feature space, and provide methods to suppress them effectively.

arxiv-2105-12150.title: Diameter, radius and all eccentricities in linear time for constant-dimension median graphs An extended abstract of this paper will appear at LAGOS 2021. This is the full version.
arxiv-2105-12150.creator: Pierre Bergé, Michel Habib
arxiv-2105-12150.description: Abstract Median graphs form the class of graphs which is the most studied in metric graph theory. Recently, Bénéteau et al. [2019] designed a linear-time algorithm computing both the Θ \Theta -classes and the median set of median graphs. A natural question emerges: is there a linear-time algorithm computing the diameter and the radius for median graphs?

arxiv-2112-03949.creator: The CMS Collaboration
arxiv-2112-03949.description: Abstract A search is presented for a right-handed \PW boson ( \PWR ) and a heavy neutrino ( N \mathrm{N} ), in a final state consisting of two same-flavor leptons ( \Pe ​ \Pe \Pe\Pe or \PGm ​ \PGm \PGm\PGm ) and two quarks.

arxiv-2112-13197.title: Learning Multi-granularity Consecutive User Intent Unit for Session-based Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the Fifteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; February 21–25, 2022; Tempe, AZ, USA Proceedings of the Fifteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search a
arxiv-2112-13197.creator: Jiayan Guo 1∗ , Yaming Yang 2 , Xiangchen Song 3∗ , Yuan Zhang 1 , Yujing Wang 2 Jing Bai 4 , Yan Zhang 1
arxiv-2112-13197.description: Abstract . Session-based recommendation aims to predict a user’s next action based on previous actions in the current session. The major challenge is to capture authentic and complete user preferences in the entire session. Recent work utilizes graph structure to represent the entire session and adopts Graph Neural Network (GNN) to encode session information.

arxiv-2205-14515.title: Additive Higher-Order Factorization Machines Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation emai; 2023; January
arxiv-2205-14515.creator: David Rügamer
arxiv-2205-14515.description: Abstract . In the age of big data and interpretable machine learning, approaches need to work at scale and at the same time allow for a clear mathematical understanding of the method’s inner workings. While there exist inherently interpretable semi-parametric regression techniques for large-scale applications to account for non-linearity in the data, their model complexity is still often restricted.

arxiv-2209-09926.title: Orbital motion near Sagittarius A ∗
arxiv-2209-09926.creator: M. Wielgus, M. Moscibrodzka, J. Vos, Z. Gelles, I. Martí-Vidal, J. Farah, N. Marchili, C. Goddi, H. Messias
arxiv-2209-09926.description: Abstract We report on the polarized light curves of the Galactic Center supermassive black hole Sagittarius A ∗ , obtained at millimeter wavelength with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA). The observations took place as a part of the Event Horizon Telescope campaign.

arxiv-2303-03112.title: Data-driven stability analysis of a chaotic time-delayed system Thanks: This research has received financial support from the ERC Starting Grant No. PhyCo 949388.
arxiv-2303-03112.creator: Georgios Margazoglou, Luca Magri
arxiv-2303-03112.description: Abstract Systems with time-delayed chaotic dynamics are common in nature, from control theory to aeronautical propulsion. The overarching objective of this paper is to compute the stability properties of a chaotic dynamical system, which is time-delayed. The stability analysis is based only on data.

arxiv-2306-07089.title: Topology Repairing of Disconnected Pulmonary Airways and Vessels: Baselines and a Dataset
arxiv-2306-07089.creator: Ziqiao Weng, Jiancheng Yang, Dongnan Liu, Weidong Cai
arxiv-2306-07089.description: Abstract Accurate segmentation of pulmonary airways and vessels is crucial for the diagnosis and treatment of pulmonary diseases. However, current deep learning approaches suffer from disconnectivity issues that hinder their clinical usefulness. To address this challenge, we propose a post-processing approach that leverages a data-driven method to repair the topology of disconnected pulmonary tubular structures.

arxiv-2308-16579.title: Highest Cusped Waves for the Fractional KdV Equations
arxiv-2308-16579.creator: Joel Dahne
arxiv-2308-16579.description: Abstract In this paper we prove the existence of highest, cusped, traveling wave solutions for the fractional KdV equations f t + f ​ f x = | D | α ​ f x f_{t}+ff_{x}=|D|^{\alpha}f_{x} for all α ∈ ( − 1 , 0 ) \alpha\in(-1,0) and give their exact leading asymptotic behavior at zero.

arxiv-2310-08324.title: Adding a constant and an axiom to a doctrine
arxiv-2310-08324.creator: Francesca Guffanti
arxiv-2310-08324.description: Abstract We study the meaning of “adding a constant to a language” for any doctrine, and “adding an axiom to a theory” for a primary doctrine, by showing how these are actually two instances of the same construction. We prove their universal properties, and how these constructions are compatible with additional structure on the doctrine.

arxiv-2406-08847.title: Roping in Uncertainty: Robustness and Regularization in Markov Games
arxiv-2406-08847.creator: Jeremy McMahan, Giovanni Artiglio, Qiaomin Xie
arxiv-2406-08847.description: Abstract We study robust Markov games (RMG) with s s -rectangular uncertainty. We show a general equivalence between computing a robust Nash equilibrium (RNE) of a s s -rectangular RMG and computing a Nash equilibrium (NE) of an appropriately constructed regularized MG.

arxiv-2407-11493.title: Using Recurrent Neural Networks to Predict Aspects of 3-D Structure of Folded Copolymer Sequences
arxiv-2407-11493.creator: Ronan G. Reilly, M-Tahar Kechadi, Yuri A. Kuznetosov, Edward G. Timoshenko, and Kenneth A. Dawson
arxiv-2407-11493.description: Abstract The neural network techniques are developed for artificial sequences based on approximate models of proteins. We only encode the hydrophobicity of the amino acid side chains without attempting to model the secondary structure. We use our approach to obtain a large set of sequences with known 3-D structures for training the neural network.

arxiv-2409-02352.title: Upstream Allocation of Bidirectional Load Demand by Power Packetization
arxiv-2409-02352.creator: Shiu Mochiyama, Kento Hiwatashi, and Takashi Hikihara
arxiv-2409-02352.description: Abstract The power packet dispatching system has been studied for power management with strict tie to an accompanying information system through power packetization. In the system, integrated units of transfer of power and information, called power packets, are delivered through a network of apparatuses called power packet routers.

arxiv-2510-16772.title: REGION IN CONTEXT: TEXT-CONDITIONED IMAGE EDITING WITH HUMAN-LIKE SEMANTIC REASONING
arxiv-2510-16772.creator: Thuy Phuong VuFaculty of Electrical and Electronic EngineeringSchool of EngineeringPhenikaa UniversityHanoi, VietnamDinh-Cuong HoangGreenwich VietnamFPT UniversityHanoi, Vietnam, Minhhuy LeFaculty of Electrical and Electronic EngineeringSchool of EngineeringPhenikaa UniversityHanoi, Vietnam huy.lemi
arxiv-2510-16772.description: Abstract Recent research has made significant progress in localizing and editing image regions based on text. However, most approaches treat these regions in isolation, relying solely on local cues without accounting for how each part contributes to the overall visual and semantic composition. This often results in inconsistent edits, unnatural transitions, or loss of coherence across the image.

pmc-10689682.title: Physician- and Patient-Reported Severity and Quality of Life Impact of Alopecia Areata: Results from a Real-World Survey in Five European Countries
pmc-10689682.creator: Sergio Vañó-Galván, Ulrike Blume-Peytavi, Paul Farrant, Pascal Reygagne, Erin Johansson, Catherine Reed, Simran Marwaha, Frederick Durand, Bianca Maria Piraccini
pmc-10689682.description: IntroductionAlopecia areata (AA) can negatively affect quality of life (QoL) and is associated with increased prevalence of anxiety and depression (vs people without AA). This study compared physician-assessed and patient self-rated severity of AA in a European sample and described the patient-reported burden of AA stratified by physician-assessed severity.

pmc-11356554.title: Evaluation of the Effects of Repetitive Anaesthesia Administration on the Brain Tissues and Cognitive Functions of Rats with Experimental Alzheimer’s Disease †
pmc-11356554.creator: Nuray Camgoz Eryilmaz, Mustafa Arslan, Aysegul Kucuk, Ayca Tas Tuna, Sevin Guney, Gulnur Take Kaplanoglu, Mustafa Kavutcu, Allison B Reiss
pmc-11356554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: We evaluated the effects of repeated ketamine, propofol, and ketamine + propofol administration on cognitive functions and brain tissue of elderly rat models with streptozotocin-induced Alzheimer’s disease. Materials and Methods: Thirty elderly male Wistar Albino rats were divided into five groups: control (Group C), Alzheimer’s (Group A), Alzheimer’s + ketamine (Group AK), Alzheimer’s + propofol (Group AP), and Alzheimer’s + propofol + ketamine (Group APK). Alzheimer’s disease was induced in Groups A, AK, AP, and APK via intracerebroventricular streptozotocin.

pmc-12800973.title: Tips for Successful Double-Bundle Posterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction
pmc-12800973.creator: Alexander P Decilveo, Neil Patel, Nils Calderón Tejerina, Joseph N Liu, Bruce A Levy, George F Rick Hatch
pmc-12800973.description: Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) injuries are a relatively common knee injury that can occur in isolation but are more commonly associated with multiligamentous knee injuries. PCL reconstruction is a technically challenging and complex orthopaedic procedure. Improper reconstruction techniques may result in significant complications, including residual instability, graft failure, and damage to adjacent neurovascular structures.

pmc-12832077.title: Ewing Sarcoma of the Maxilla: An Uncommon Anatomical Presentation in a Young Patient
pmc-12832077.creator: José R Velázquez-Soto, Daniel Rosales-Rosales, Carlos A Jaimes-Loreto, Lizeth R Ríos-Bañuelos, Rachel V Cárdenas-Cabral, Quitzia L Torres-Salazar
pmc-12832077.description: Ewing sarcoma (ES) of the maxilla is an exceptionally rare entity that can mimic odontogenic or inflammatory conditions, often resulting in diagnostic delay. We report the case of a 23-year-old female who presented with a painless, progressively enlarging swelling of the anterior maxilla. Imaging demonstrated an expansile osteolytic lesion with cortical disruption.

pmc-13570305.title: Barriers and Capacity for Prosthetic Dental Care in Myanmar: A Cross-sectional Survey
pmc-13570305.creator: Tun Min Bo, Duangporn Duangthip, Nay Aung, Palinee Detsomboonrat
pmc-13570305.description: Introduction and AimsLimited evidence exists on prosthetic dental care in Myanmar. This study aimed to assess prosthodontic service capacity, practitioner-perceived barriers, teledentistry use, and training needs.MethodsA cross-sectional online survey was conducted among dentists providing prosthodontic treatment in Myanmar (November-December 2025), using convenience sampling. The questionnaire covered demographics, service capacity, barriers, teledentistry, and training needs.

pmc-13660583.creator: Scott Goldstein, Nathaniel Zahustecher, Derek Isenberg, Eric Rosen, Celine Bennett

Currently, medetomidine, a veterinary anesthetic that acts as an alpha-2-adrenergic agonist, is a common adulterant in the illicit opioid supply, causing both unique overdose and withdrawal syndromes.
